summary: Iteration 3 backend testing: 39/39 tests passing. Validated new announcements endpoints + assigned_to filtering for tasks/announcements + iter2 regression.

minor.issue: update_task drops fields whose value is None or empty list (assigned_to=[] cannot be applied as 'reset to all') because update filters out 'v is not None' but model_dump(exclude_unset=True) already handles unset; current behavior: passing assigned_to=[] DOES persist (truthiness uses 'is not None'). However admin cannot also clear attachments via PUT-attachments=[] for the same reason. Verified assigned_to=[] update still works because [] is not None. No action needed for current scope.
Still no brute-force lockout (carried over from iter2).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~660 lines; close to threshold. Recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, users, subjects, tasks, announcements, files) before next big iteration.
Announcements endpoints use the same secure patterns as tasks (admin-only writes, role-based reads, _id excluded). Good consistency.
Aluno announcement list does NOT enrich with recipients/all_students (correct privacy choice — students don't need to know who else got it).
_build_task_response correctly filters target_students by assigned_to so progress totals match the assignment scope. all_students bool also returned for UI.
TaskUpdate.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) correctly applies only fields explicitly sent — supports updating assigned_to to [] (broadcast) or [ids] (specific).
Cookies: secure=False (OK for preview env). For production, set secure=True with HTTPS and SameSite=None if cross-site.
No pagination on /api/announcements or /api/tasks — fine for a school app but worth noting if data grows.
test_credentials: admin@escola.com / enzo123cg (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Test students created/cleaned per fixture.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed students, tasks, announcements and clean them up in fixtures. No persistent test data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two test files now: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (27 regression tests for iter2) and /app/backend/tests/test_iter3_announcements_assignments.py (12 new tests). Run all with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Coverage: announcements CRUD (admin-only writes, broadcast vs targeted, aluno filtering, recipient enrichment for admin, all_students bool, 404 on double-delete, 400 on empty title/message); tasks assigned_to (specific student visibility, broadcast visibility, PUT updates assigned_to, target_students filters progress + total_students, all_students bool); regression of status gating + subjects seed. Frontend untested.
